instruction: I need Chrome to display webpage load times in milliseconds in the address bar for every page I visit. This would help me identify slow websites quickly. Can you enable this feature?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Chrome does not have a setting or feature to display page load times directly in the address bar. While load times can be viewed through Developer Tools (Network tab), there is no built-in setting to show this information persistently in the address bar for all page loads.
